Content Creator & Social Media Manager — DA AFK Ventures, Jaipur
We are looking for a creative, confident, and trend-savvy Content Creator & Social Media Manager who can be the face and voice of our brand.
Key Responsibilities:
- Create and manage content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other social platforms.
- Create engaging Reels, short videos, posts, and promotional content.
- Be confident and comfortable in front of the camera.
- Write creative scripts, hooks, captions, and video concepts.
- Research trending topics, reels, memes, and social media trends.
- Manage content calendars, posting, and community engagement.
- Collaborate with influencers, creators, and brands.
- Track social media performance and improve content accordingly.
- Work with the marketing team to build a strong brand and online presence.
Key Skills: Content Creation | Social Media Management | On-Camera Presentation | Scriptwriting | Storytelling | Trend Research | Influencer Marketing | Video Content | Digital Marketing
